subject: general
question: The Integrated Child Protection Scheme was launched in the year:
solution:
The correct answer is __**2009-2010.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Integrated Child Protection Scheme** (ICPS) was launched in the year **2009-10** and is committed to children.
 
• The Scheme is established by the **Central government.**
 
• This scheme is relevant for **children in need of care and protection and children in conflict.**
 
• The Integrated Child Protection Scheme (ICPS) is a centrally sponsored scheme aimed **at building a protective environment for children in difficult circumstances.**

 [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSRd3bFGAnUHfAvt73ZrV_CcXzdlJ-MirAT2g&usqp=CAU] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana** is a Small Savings Scheme of the Government of India meant exclusively for a girl child. 
 
• A Child Education Plan is **an insurance policy that offers protection as well as an opportunity for saving money to ensure a secure future for your child**.
 
• The child Welfare scheme's aim was to **provide provisions for nutrition, shelter, sanitation, health care, and hygiene**.
